name: @rxap/generator-ts-morph
description: This package provides a deprecated `AddDir` export, which is now recommended to be imported from `@rxap/workspace-ts-morph`. It also includes an init generator that helps manage peer dependencies for other `@rxap` packages, ensuring they are correctly added to either `dependencies` or `devDependencies` in the project's `package.json`. The generator also attempts to run the init generator of the peer dependencies.
